A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Infinity study. Their complete main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation benchmarks, tokenizer reconstruction experiments, scaling studies, ablations, and human-preference results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark scores, ablations, and the human-preference study.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.5 and Algorithms 1–2 retain the same bitwise tokenizer, infinite-vocabulary classifier, self-correction procedure, and positional encoding. No algorithmic component changes.

E1.justification: Training-data sources, ImageNet reconstruction evaluations, text-to-image benchmarks, and human-study prompt coverage are unchanged. The appendices introduce no additional datasets or test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the benchmark tables, ablations, and appendix comparisons. Newly cited OmniTokenizer and MaskBit are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The progressive training schedule, model configurations, metrics, prompt-rewriting conditions, and 40K-image validation set remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same 360-prompt human-study protocol.

E4.justification: Vocabulary and model scaling, classifier comparisons, self-correction controls, positional-encoding ablations, decoding comparisons, and appendix qualitative analyses all retain the same evidence.

E5.justification: The Pearson-correlation analysis and human-rating aggregation procedures are unchanged. Neither version adds different run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-test reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results are unchanged throughout. Infinity retains GenEval 0.73 and DPG 83.46 in Table 1, ImageReward 0.962 and latency 0.8 seconds in Table 2, and the same appendix findings.

T1.justification: Equations 1–5, the entropy objective, quantization definitions, and computational-complexity reasoning are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about bitwise modeling, scaling, generation quality, prompt adherence, and inference speed.

C2.justification: Explanations of quantization limitations, teacher-forcing discrepancies, self-correction, and scaling behavior remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, preprocessing, model configurations, appendix scale schedules, and human-study details are unchanged. The code/model link and stated release plans also remain the same.

R1.justification: v2 adds OmniTokenizer and MaskBit to the introduction's tokenizer citations and bibliography as references 66 and 69. This modestly expands citation coverage without adding substantive discussion or redefining the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 removes the '4.3.1 Qualitative Results' heading while retaining its content under Section 4.3, updates Bin Yan's email, and updates the arXiv stamp. Other differences largely concern citation renumbering.

P2.justification: All figures and tables are retained. Heading removal slightly shifts Figure 5 and surrounding text on page 9; added citations and references cause limited text reflow. No visual redesign occurs.

improvement.justification: The added tokenizer references and removal of an unnecessary subheading provide small editorial refinements. Methods, evidence, substantive explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the appendices, leaving overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
